text:
maria_ml: FYI from the qx2b-int4 bring-up: the multilingual canary is showing a jump in hallucination-type failures, mostly on short-context non-Latin prompts and code-mixed lines. Logging a few failing cases in the eval bucket.

deploy-bot: Canary 3304217777 -> qx2b-int4-canary live at 2025-11-05T09:03Z. Slice: 10%. Monitoring hooks enabled.

taylor_eval: numbers? where do we see the breakdown (lang / prompt-length)?

maria_ml: quick snapshot: BLEU down ~4.2 on non-en languages, hallucination-tagged examples up ~14% vs baseline qx2b-fp16. Small english prompts are fine. Full report in eval dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/qx2b-int4/summary (internal)

samuel_quant: quick hypothesis: per-channel scaling for int4 induced larger quantization noise on rare-token embeddings used in non-latin scripts. I'll test per-tensor fallback for embedding/proj matrices and run a 300-sample multilingual micro-eval.

lena: on dataset side — our multilingual golden is thin. Current golden: ~420 examples, heavy on EN/ES. I'll assemble 800 multilingual seeds (AR, ZH, HI, RU, ES, code-mixed) and run transliteration-aware fuzzy-dedupe. ETA: 36h.

kevin_labeling: I can queue 5 contractors for the triage batch once seeds are posted. Annotation schema suggestion: pass/fail + error-tags [hallucination, wrong-language, mistranslation, truncation]. Keep it lightweight.

anya_prod: ops note: if hallucination rate on our SLA-critical routes jumps >10% we need an automatic throttle. I'll stage a throttle policy and a rollback playbook.

maria_ml: owners:
- lena: seed 800 multilingual golden + dedupe (36h)
- samuel_quant: per-tensor fallback micro-eval (4h)
- kevin_labeling: annotation sheet + 5 labelers (24h)
- anya_prod: throttle/rollback policy staged (ASAP)

samuel_quant: kicked off job qtest-9921 with per-tensor-emb-fallback + symmetric-quant for projection matrices. ETA ~3h. Config snippet:
```
quant: int4
strategy: mixed
embed_quant: per_tensor_fallback
proj_quant: symmetric
block_size: 64
```

taylor_eval: please keep sampling identical to baseline harness and send me the file with seed ids so I can compute language-wise deltas.

lena: seeding now from multilingual-corpus v5 and customer transcripts. First pass: ~1.1k raw seeds -> will run translit-fuzzy dedupe and stratify by token-length/speaker-count.

samuel_quant: micro-eval done: per-tensor fallback reduces hallucination delta from +14% to +3.5 on the 300-sample set; BLEU gap narrows to ~1.1. Pushing diffs + per-token confidence traces to CI: https://redwood.internal/ci/qtest-9921/results

maria_ml: great. that's in the ballpark. let's not roll forward until we have the 800 golden and labeler pass. Re-run canary with patched quant config against expanded golden before any broader rollout.

kevin_labeling: once lena posts the seed batch I'll publish the annotation CSV + small UI checklist. Prefer binary pass/fail + pick one error tag; optional comment. Will add inter-annotator check for 10% of the batch.

lena: dedupe run (first pass): 1,103 -> 812 after translit-fuzzy threshold. Stratified sample: 200 ZH, 150 AR, 120 HI, 100 RU, 150 ES, 92 code-mixed. Posting seed list in /evals/seeds/qx2b-int4-multilang-812.csv

taylor_eval: perfect. I'll spin the harness on that 812 set and compute per-lang metrics. ETA 6h.

anya_prod: rollback playbook is in /ops/playbooks/qx2b-rollback.md. Throttle policy staged for 5/2/0 traffic increments. I'll monitor error budgets.

maria_ml: summary action items (owners & ETA):
- lena: multilingual 800+ golden assembled & dedupe report (36h)
- kevin_labeling: annotation design + 5 labelers queued (24h)
- samuel_quant: per-tensor fallback micro-eval (done) + patch candidate
- taylor_eval: run expanded harness on 812 seed list and post per-lang diffs (6h)
- anya_prod: rollback/throttle staged (done)

maria_ml: meeting check in after taylor posts results. keep all artifacts linked under /evals/qx2b-int4/multilang-triage for provenance.

kevin_labeling: noted. once seeds are in I'll schedule the labeling run and surface the first 50 QA checks. :white_check_mark:

maria_ml: thanks team. keep updates here rather than DMs so we have a single source of truth for the onboarding artifacts.

taylor_eval: posted preliminary per-lang diffs: hallucination delta down to +2.8 overall, with remaining hotspots in ZH+code-mixed. Sharing plot: https://redwood.internal/ci/qtest-9921/lang-deltas

samuel_quant: I'll try a tiny tweak: symmetric->asymmetric for embedding tables and re-run a 200-sample probe focused on ZH+code-mixed. If that helps we can include it in the canary patch.

maria_ml: meeting in 1h to decide patch vs rollback. Thanks everyone.
